title: Rice-Stuffed Tomatoes
subtitle: baked in their own sauce, served with tzatziki
description: Ripe tomatoes stuffed with herbed rice and pine nuts and baked in a tray with a simple tomato and oregano sauce, served with tzatziki.

steps.text: Cut the tops off the tomatoes and keep them as lids. Scoop out the insides with a teaspoon.

For the sauce, roughly chop the tomato flesh and put it in a deep baking tray (6 cm sides). Add 1 finely chopped small onion, 2 tbsp olive oil and the sugar, season with oregano, salt and pepper, mix, taste and adjust.

For the filling, heat a large frying pan over medium heat, add 1/4 cup olive oil and 1 large finely chopped onion and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft. Add the rinsed and well-drained rice and fry for about 1 minute until hot and coated in oil. Add the pine nuts and fry for another minute.

Pour in the boiling water, season with salt and pepper, stir and bring back to the boil. Reduce the heat and cook uncovered for 6 to 8 minutes until the water is absorbed. Stir in the herbs and cool slightly.
Fill each tomato almost to the top with the rice mixture, cover with its lid and set in the tray with the sauce.
Bake uncovered for about 40 minutes, until the tomatoes are golden and soft. Serve hot with tzatziki.
